report: Read all 17 verses end to end, including the 10 added units the lemma table cannot see. No construction is analysed two ways without a source difference to license it.

Suffix, waw, לֹא, בְּ and מִן buckets all follow the ASV's own word: connectives read off the text (Then/and/but/So/that/where/even/For/Neither), 'cannot' to לֹא in all three places (rule 35), 'more than' headed on 'than' (rule 24).

מִן + פָּנֶה is consistent: fused to 'before' where the ASV writes one word (23.17a, rule 30) and split where פָּנֶה has its own word ('at his presence' 23.15, 'from my face' 23.17b, rule 2). Same logic for לִפְנֵי → 'before' at 23.4.

Supplied subordinators over asyndetic clauses are added in every verse that has one (23.3 'That', 23.5 'which', 23.10 'When', 23.15 'When'); where a preposition or waw stands to carry the word it takes it (23.9 בְּ → 'when', waw → 'that'). Apodosis waws the ASV leaves bare are unrepresented at 23.12 and 23.15, matching rules 14 and 52.

Supplied possessives with no suffix are added at 23.4 and 23.6; every other possessive in the chapter has a suffix. Supplied object pronouns with no object morpheme are added at 23.9 (twice); 23.13's 'what' is a free-relative recasting placed under rule 46 with the competing rule-44 reading named in its note, so it is a different construction and not a split.
Phrasal particles (forth, back, up, aside, off, fast) are kept with their verbs throughout on the rule 44 lexeme test; none states a direction the Hebrew leaves unwritten.

Verse-level judgment calls with a named competing reading (23.3 waw → 'where', 23.10 עִמָּדִי → 'that ... take', 23.12 'from' on the fronted noun, 23.12 'necessary food' head, 23.17 'thick darkness' head) are each defensible under the cited rules and were left as the verse pass returned them.
BSB disagreements (23.8 dative לְ, 23.12 and 23.15 apodosis waws) are documented convention differences under rules 40 and 14; none is an error.
The two repeated notes restate rules 55 and 18 verbatim, so no convention is recorded. Nothing here generalises beyond the contract; no promotions or amendments.
